question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "commented" **is in the** past tense, which matches the narrative tense of the passage.**
 
• Using the** past tense "commented" **ensures that the sentence remains consistent with the **past narrative of the story.**
 
• The word **"commented"** correctly introduces the direct speech that follows** ("Every day he...").**
 
• This choice provides a** smooth transition from the description of events to the customer's remark.**
 
• In narrative writing, reported speech or actions typically use the past tense to maintain a coherent timeline.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (comments): "Comments"** is in the present tense and does not match the past tense narrative.
 
• **Option 3 (comment):** **"Comment"** is the base form of the verb and is not appropriate for this context.
 
• **Option 4 (commenting):** **"Commenting" **is the present participle and does not fit the structure of the sentence.
